title: melafit: Python package for high-precision circadian melatonin profile analysis
description: Python package for high-precision modeling of 24-hour melatonin secretion profiles. Implements baseline cosine functions (BCF, SBCF, BBCF, BSBCF) for curve fitting and a robust cost function for superior convergence, even with sparse data. Provides circadian phase markers including DLMOn, DLMOff, midpoint, amplitude, area under the curve and center of gravity.
